paite: Huan Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih uh. Huchi in TOUPA'N Midiante khut ah kum sagih sung apekhia hi.
heading: Gideon

paite: Midiante'n Israelte azouta ua; huchi in Midiante ziak in tang ah kokhukte, kohawm leh kulhte abawl uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israelte'n haichi achin khit un Midiante, Amalekte leh suahlam mite ahong kuan ua; ava dou ua,
panmun ava khoh ua, Gaza tan in lei a thilpoute ahihsiatsak ua, Israel gam ah nek ding himhim ahawi kei ua, belam, bawng leh sabiltung tan in ahihse vek uhi.
Aganhonte uh leh apuaninte uh toh ahong kuan ua, khaupe bang in tampi ahong kuan ua; amaute leh asangawngsaute uh sim seng ahi kei, gam hihse dia hong kuan ahi uhi.
Huchi in Midiante ziak in Israelte akeniam mahmahta ua; huchi in Israel suante'n TOUPA asamta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Midiante ziak a Israel suante'n TOUPA asaptak un, TOUPA'N Israel suante kiang ah zawlnei khat asawl a; ama'n akiang uah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in, hichi in achi:
'Aigupta gam a pan ka hon pitou a, saltanna inn a pan ka hon pikhia hi.
Aiguptate khut a pan leh nou hon nuaisiah mi teng khut a pan ka hon hunkhia a, na ma uah amaute ka delhkhia a, agam uh nou ka hon pia hi.
Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, agam ua na tenna uh Amorte pathiante na lau ding uh ahi kei, ka chi hỉ'. Himahleh ka thugen na zui kei uh," achi hi.
Huan TOUPA angel ahong pai a, Ophrah a Abiezer mi Joash tosaw sing nuai ah atu hi. Atapa Gideon in Midiante muh louh ding in grep sukna khuk ah buh ana vua hi.
TOUPA angel akiang ah ahong kilak a, akiang ah, "Nang mihat hangsan, na kiang ah TOUPA a-om hi,” achi hi.

Gideon in akiang ah, "Aw ka toupa, ka kiang ua TOUPA om ahihleh bangchidan a hichibang a ka tung ua hiai thilte hong tung ahia? Ka pipute un, TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan hon pitou hilou hia? chi a, athilhih lamdang ahon hilhte uh koilam a bangchi khinta ahia? Tu'n zaw, TOUPA'N hon pampaih ahita a, Midiante khut a hon peta ei ve," achi hi.
TOUPA'N, amah a-en a, akiang ah, "Hiai na hatna in kuan in, Midiante a pan Israelte hunkhia in. K'on sawl ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, “Aw TOUPA, bangchi in ahia Israelte ka va hutkhiak mahmah ding? Ngai in, Manasseh suan lak a inkuan hatloupen ka hi ua, kei lah ka pa inkote lak a neupen ka hi ngal a," achi hi.
TOUPA'N, akiang ah, "Na kiang ah ka om ngeingei ding hi, huchi in Midiante mi khat lel bang in na zou vek ding," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh, nang mahmah in na hon pi chih chiamtehna banghiam hon musak in.
Na ma a lat ding thilpiak ka va lak a, na kiang a ka hong nawn masiah hiai a pan hehpih in ana paimang ke'n," achi hi. Ama'n, "Na hong nawn masiah ka na om gige ding," achi hi.
Insung ah Gideon alut a, kelnou leh tangbuang ephah khat silngou soh louh abawl a; seng ah asa akoih a, huai gel tuibel ah akoih a, tosaw sing nuai ah akiang a hon tawi in ahong lan hi.
Pathian angel in akiang ah, "Sa leh tanghou silngou soh louh la inla, hiai suang tung ah koih inla, atui pen sungkhia in,” achi hi. Huchibang in ama'n ahihta hi.

Huchi in TOUPA angel in achiangkhun tawi muk in sa leh tanghou silngou soh louh akhoih a; suang a pan mei ahong pawt a, sa leh tanghou silngou soh louh akangtum vek hi. Huan amuhlouhna ah TOUPA angel in apaimangsanta hi.
Huchi in Gideon in, TOUPA angel ahi chih atheita hi. Gideon in, "Maizen, Aw Toupa PATHIAN, TOUPA angel kimaituah a mu ka kei maw," achi hi. "
TOUPA'N akiang ah, Lungmuangtak in om inla, lau ke'n. Na si kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Gideon in huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh a, Jehovah Shalom asa hi. Tuni tan in Abiezerte gam Ophrah ah a-om lai hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai zan mah in TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Na pa bawngtaltuai, bawngtal nihna kum sagih a upa la inla, na pa neih Baal maitam hihchim inla, abul a sing a bawl Asherah phuk in.
Hiai suangpi tung ah zeneitak in TOUPA na Pathian a ding in maitam bawl inla, bawngtal nihna la inla, na phuk ding Asherah sing zang in halmang thillat lan in," achi hi.

Huchi in Gideon in asikhate lak a mi sawm api a, TOUPA'N akiang a agen bang in ahihta hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, apa inkote leh khopi a mite alauh ziak in, sun lai in ahih ngam kei a, zan lai in ahihta hi.
Khopi a mite zingkhang a athoh uleh, ngai in, Baal maitam hihchip in ana om a, abul a Ashera phukpaih in ana om a, maitam tung ah bawngtal nihna lat in ana om hi.
"Hiai kua hih ahia?" chi in akihou ua, akidongtuah ua, azon khit un, "Joash tapa Gideon in hiai thil ahih ana hi,” achi uhi.
Huchi in khopi a mite'n Joash kiang ah, "Na tapa va pikhia in, asih ngeingei ding ahi. Baal maitam ahihchip ziak leh abul a Asherah aphuk ziak in,” achi uhi.

"Joash in amah hong kalh teng kiang ah, Baal gum ding na hi uh maw? Ama'n hon hondam ding hia? Kuapeuh amah gum zingsang mahmah a thah ding ahi. Pathian khat ahihleh amaitam ahihchip ziak in kigum leh akei dia," achi hi.
Huaiziak in huai ni in amah Jerubbaal asa uhi, amaitam hihchip ahih ziak in, "Baal in amah kalh heh," achi uhi.
Huchi in Midiante tengteng leh Amalekte leh suahlam mite akikhawm ua; lui akan ua, Jezreel Phaizang ah akikulh uhi.
Himahleh, TOUPA Kha Gideon tung ah ahong tung a; pengkul amut a; huchi in Abiezerte'n amah agum uhi.
Manasseh tengteng kiang ah mi ataisak a; huaite'n leng anaihkhawm uhi. Asherte, Zebulunte leh Naphtali teng kiang ah leng mite ataisak a; amau leng abehlaptouta uhi.
Gideon in Pathian kiang ah, "Na gen bang a ka khut a Israelte na hutkhiak dingleh,
ngai in, buhphual ah belam mul ka koih dia, belam mul tung kia a daitui ana om a, leitual ana hul vekleh, na gen bang in ka khut in Israelte na hunkhe ding, chih ka thei ding," achi hi.
Huchibang ahong hi a, azing zingsangpi a thou a, belam mul asukleh belkuang dim tui atakkhia hi.

Gideon in Pathian kiang ah, "Ka tung ah heh ke'n, khatvei kia ka hon gen nawn ding. Hehpih in, khatvei kia belam mul in hon ze-etsak nawn in. Tutung in ahihleh belam mul kia hul henla, leitual ah daitui om nawn leuleu hen," achi hi.
Huchibang in Pathian in huai zan in ahih a; belam mul kia ana hul a, leitual ah daitui ana om leuleu hi.
